content: kubernetes-client/python exposes Configuration.client_side_validation (bool) as a global-object toggle for validation strictness, with per-model override via a local_vars_configuration parameter. Its actual scope is narrow (mostly permitting None values); unknown attributes are dropped during deserialization regardless. Useful as a precedent for 'policy lives on a config object threaded into the decoder, overridable per call site', weak as a precedent for divergence reporting.
